verdict.rationale: EFTPS publishes its operating window up front: it is available 24/7, and payments must be scheduled by 8 p.m. ET the day before the due date. The evidence says nothing about per-day payment limits or a session timeout for the online flow. missing for 10: published per-day/per-payment limits, published session timeout, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start

citations.quote: Make your tax payment from home or office, 24/7.
Payments using this Web site or our voice response system must be scheduled by 8 p.m. ET the day before the due date to be received timely by the IRS.
